title: Happy dolphin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7fd8ff'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='4.2' fill='#123a55'/>
